name: Hands Of The Forgotten
description: Ethereal hands stretch out from the walls and floor, attempting to restrain nearby creatures.
disable: DC 30 Religion check (master) to exorcise the spirits or DC 32 Intimidation check (expert) to scare away the hands

offensiveAbilities.name: Waylay
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the area marked on the map

Effect Misty blue hands stretch out from the hallway's stone tiles and grasp at the triggering creature, which must attempt a DC 26 Reflex save to avoid becoming hindered or harmed by the ethereal hands.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is Slowed 2 for 1 round and takes 2d10+10 void damage.

Critical Failure The target is Slowed 2 for 1 round and takes 4d10+15 void damage.
